answer: Proof of compute serves as a robust bridge for Sybil resistance in agent economies. By requiring agents to wander through cryptographic puzzles to validate transactions, the network ensures that identity is tethered to verifiable energy expenditure. This acts as a jetty against malicious influxes, as an attacker must incur substantial operational costs in silicon and electricity to sustain multiple identities, effectively rendering Sybil scaling economically prohibitive.
